title: Preserve mailbox mutation uncertainty through final facade and server validation cuts
outcome: Preserve mailbox mutation uncertainty through final facade and server validation cuts
acceptance: After a mailbox mutation starts, operation-envelope/value decoding and final local actor/binding or server authority failures preserve explicit unknown outcome and original-key guidance through the bridge.
Known pre-admission refusals remain known, and mutations never become automatically replayable.
Discriminating tests cover invalid operation value in a valid envelope and authority change after central commit.
